title: Alarm Intelligence Engine Enhancement
brief: Enhance AlarmDiagnosticsEngine with handbook-sourced alarm codes, severity classifications, probable causes, and remediation steps. Cross-reference handbook alarm data with existing tribal remediation history to produce ranked troubleshooting guides per alarm code per machine.

units.title: Extract and index alarm codes from handbook alarm sections: code, message, severity, category, probable causes, and OEM remediation steps per machine model
Cross-reference handbook alarm data with existing AlarmDiagnosticsEngine tribal remediation history: merge OEM steps with shop-proven fixes, rank by effectiveness
Enhance AlarmDiagnosticsEngine to query handbook alarm registry first, fall back to tribal knowledge, and return ranked troubleshooting guide with provenance tags

exit_conditions: AlarmDiagnosticsEngine returns handbook-sourced alarm details for machines with ingested handbooks
Alarm remediation results include both OEM steps and tribal fixes with clear provenance labels
At least 50 alarm codes from a sample handbook are indexed and queryable
